confirmed_task:

Stopping condition: Stop after the title, publisher, published date, type, and complete ordered author list have been recorded from the message object.

Constraints:
- Use only the supplied Crossref response.
- Read the date from message.published.date-parts and authors from message.author.
- Preserve the author order and name spelling exactly as returned.
- Do not substitute metadata from DOI.org or the publisher page.
